profile_text.body:
Super Micro Computer, Inc. is a public company headquartered in San Jose, California, trading under the ticker SMCI. Its own site describes it as a provider of advanced Server Building Block Solutions for 5G/Edge, Data Center, Cloud, Enterprise, Big Data, HPC and Embedded markets worldwide. The company also presents GPU servers for modern data centers, describing its AI systems as featuring multi-GPU and interconnect technologies, and offers short-depth and small form factor systems intended to bring compute, AI, and connectivity performance to the edge of the network.

Its litigation exposure is recorded in California, with 281 cases. No products or MCP servers are tracked for the company.
